findings.highlight: I need to think of another way that won't involve Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: しばらくは顔を合わせない方がいいのだろうか
findings.governingReading: しばらくは顔を合わせない方がいいのだろうか questions a temporary pause in facing Shinji after yesterday, not a new condition concerning Sakura.
findings.explanation: Wondering whether to avoid Shinji for a while becomes finding another way that will not involve Sakura.

findings.governingReading: Shirou notices that Taiga is more energetic than usual, contrary to his assumption that she overslept.
findings.explanation: The English changes extra energy into Taiga's usual cheerfulness. Her unusually early arrival remains, but Shirou's observation that she is livelier than normal is lost.

findings.highlight: the cafeteria on the ground floor
findings.governingReading: 購買 is the shop where he picks up the bun and tea, distinguished from 食堂 later in this scene.
findings.explanation: The school shop becomes the cafeteria.

findings.highlight: In first period it was fine; by second period it was going up; third period it was like I was at a run
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の動悸はおさまるどころかテンポをあげる一方
findings.governingReading: 一時限目が終わって through 四時限目が始まって lists elapsed periods; おさまるどころかテンポをあげる一方 was increasing instead of settling.
findings.explanation: An uninterrupted rise in nervous heartbeat gains an initially calm first period and invented staged intensities.

findings.highlight: you're bragging that you could have come to the same conclusion all on your own?
findings.governingReading: のろけ is boasting about an intimate/romantic relationship; her response to his Sakura gratitude leads to his blush and protest.
findings.explanation: Rin teasing him about romantic bragging becomes generic bragging about independent reasoning.

findings.highlight: I was still going to ask Sakura to stay over tomorrow if she's feeling down.
findings.evidenceJa: うちに泊めようって思うだろ、ふつう
findings.governingReading: 思うだろ、ふつう recruits an ordinary-person norm to deny that his Sakura concern is romantic boasting.
findings.explanation: Shirou appealing to what anyone would normally do becomes only his own prior plan.

findings.evidenceJa: これ以上くっついたらすごいぞタイヘンだぞ
findings.governingReading: これ以上くっついたらすごいぞタイヘンだぞ names getting still closer as the threatened disaster before challenging her and demanding distance.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s panic over further physical closeness loses its named trigger.

findings.highlight: I shy away from Tohsaka's reach.
findings.evidenceJa: 背をエビ反りにして遠坂から顔を離す
findings.governingReading: 背をエビ反りにして遠坂から顔を離す specifies the comic backward arch and face-distance movement.
findings.explanation: Arching his back to move his face away becomes shying from Rin’s reach.

findings.highlight: you threw me for a loop.
findings.governingReading: 毒気が抜かれた states that her malicious/hostile intent has drained away, explaining the abandoned morning business.
findings.explanation: Losing hostile edge becomes merely being thrown for a loop.

findings.highlight: there's only so much they can do with it
findings.evidenceJa: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
findings.governingReading: 一度に使える魔力の最大量 contrasts maximum energy usable at once against growing stockpiles.
findings.explanation: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.

findings.highlight: to prove I'm a man of my word
findings.governingReading: 誠意を見せる motivates offering the whole tea can as good faith; no promise to give this payment has been made.
findings.explanation: Showing sincerity becomes proving that he keeps his word.
